What Will Lily Wish For?

04 · Listen and choose

Two possible futures

Clara decided to continue writing about Lily. Listen to two versions of the story. Which do you think is better? Choose one.

Listen without reading the script the first time. On your second listen, you can open the script if you need a little help.

Show listening script

Version 1

Lily woke up to an unbelievable sight. Outside her window, parked in her driveway, was a red sports car. Its surface sparkled in the sunlight. It was perfect. This was the car she had always dreamed of—power, freedom, success—all in one. She couldn’t believe it was real.

Version 2

Lily woke up in a huge house that looked like a palace. The ceilings were high, and the rooms were grand. She stood up and looked around—there were so many different rooms, it felt like this house was built for 10 families. She stepped outside onto a large balcony, feeling so small in such a vast place.

Your choice will determine what happens in the next chapter.
